environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, exposed directly via an Elastic IP on port 8080. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No reverse proxy or middleware in front of the Flask application. SQLite database stored at /tmp/app.db. Environment variable HMAC_SECRET set but unused in the search path. Application serves API consumers directly.
